symptom: MDL could not create the classic file manager (Forms$FileManager, mendixlabs/mxcli#151): `pluggablewidget 'Forms$FileManager'` gave "no definition for widget Forms$FileManager", the bare `filemanager fileManager1 (…)` was refused as MDL-WIDGET25 "`filemanager` is not a widget in this project", and `describe page` printed a stored one as a NOT re-executable comment, so describe -> exec dropped it.
cause: The type existed in modelsdk/gen and sdk/pages (with a non-metamodel ShowButton field) but had no lexer token, builder case, widgetToGen case or describe case. Since #1036 any IDENTIFIER parses as a widget type and is marked TypeIsGeneric, so an unknown built-in surfaces as a pluggable-widget lookup failure (MDL-WIDGET25), not a parse error.
file: mdl/grammar/MDLLexer.g4 + domains/MDLPage.g4 (FILEMANAGER token); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3_widgets.go (buildFileManagerV3); mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (widgetToGen case + null-slot TypeDefaults); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go / _output.go
insight: MDL-WIDGET25 on a name that is a Mendix built-in means a missing keyword, not a missing widget package: the generic-IDENTIFIER path only resolves pluggable definitions. With no Studio Pro-authored example reachable (marketplace needs a PAT, mxbuild ships no templates), the property set and defaults came from mendixmodelsdk's pages.FileManager (Type Both, MaxFileSize 5, versionInfo {} so no version gate) plus metamodel_versions_gen for which InputWidget slots are live. A clean `mx check` only counts with a control showing mx inspects the widget: the same file manager in a non-FileDocument data view gives CE6810. Builder defaults equal the SDK's, so describe omits them and still round-trips.
